2608.24325.title: SonarLLM: A Native Sonar--Optical Multimodal Large Language Model for Underwater Perception
2608.24325.paper_summary: Reliable underwater perception requires complementary sensing under variable visibility. Optical cameras capture appearance and semantics but degrade rapidly with turbidity, whereas imaging sonar preserves geometry while exhibiting distinct range-azimuth structure and acoustic artifacts. Existing MLLMs, built primarily on optical encoders, are therefore ill-suited to model sonar or adaptively exploit sonar-optical complementarity. We propose SonarLLM, a sonar-optical MLLM that treats sonar as a native perceptual modality. It combines a sonar-specific encoder, modality-specific physics-aware feature enhancement, and reliability-aware hierarchical fusion to align acoustic structure with optical semantics and dynamically adjust their contributions as sensing quality changes. We also introduce SonarBench, a paired benchmark that spans four tasks: recognition, counting, visual question answering, and captioning; and, across the benchmark, three input settings: sonar-only, optical-only, and fusion. By fixing the scene and sonar observation while varying optical degradation, SonarBench enables controlled measurement of cross-modal complementarity. SonarLLM achieves 72.0% macro accuracy across sonar-only recognition, counting, and VQA, outperforming the strongest baseline by 34.4 percentage points, and 68.7% under fusion, exceeding the best baseline by 25.1 points. For recognition and counting, the fusion-over-optical gain grows from 6.0 to 36.0 points as turbidity increases, indicating the increasing complementary value of sonar under controlled optical degradation. Together, these results show that robust heterogeneous perception depends not only on adding sonar, but on representing and weighting it according to its sensing characteristics.
2608.24325.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的水下感知需要在可變能見度下進行互補感測。光學相機捕捉外觀和語義，但在混濁的情況下迅速衰退，而成像聲納則保留幾何形狀，同時展現出明顯的範圍-方位結構和聲學工件。現有的多模態大規模模型（MLLMs），主要基於光學編碼器，因此不適合建模聲納或自適應利用聲納-光學互補性。我們提出了SonarLLM，一種將聲納視為本地感知模態的聲納-光學多模態大規模模型。它結合了專門的聲納編碼器、模態特定的物理感知特徵增強和可靠性意識的層次融合，以將聲學結構與光學語義對齊，並在感測質量變化時動態調整它們的貢獻。我們還介紹了SonarBench，一個涵蓋四個任務的配對基準：識別、計數、視覺問答和標題生成；並且在基準中有三種輸入設置：僅聲納、僅光學和融合。通過固定場景和聲納觀測，同時改變光學衰退，SonarBench使得跨模態互補性可以被控制地測量。SonarLLM在僅聲納的識別、計數和視覺問答中達到了72.0%的宏觀準確率，超過了最強基準34.4個百分點，而在融合中達到68.7%，超過了最佳基準25.1個點。對於識別和計數，隨著混濁度的增加，融合相對於光學的增益從6.0增長到36.0個點，顯示出在受控光學衰退下聲納的互補價值不斷增強。綜合這些結果顯示，穩健的異質感知不僅依賴於添加聲納，還依賴於根據其感測特性來表示和加權聲納。
